propositions: A bounded completion-recovery failure currently reports a false remedy (install agents extra) instead of the measured size versus limit, caused by recovery_failure_cause returning None for CompletionRecoveryError
Tickets whose text exceeds 24,000 chars cannot reach closed state via bounded recovery; two real tickets (34,282 and 41,595 chars) are blocked despite correct merged work
The context bound (24,000 chars) and criteria budget (32,000 chars) are mutually incoherent; a 26,000–31,900 char criteria set passes all bounds then fails on context
Elision-based compaction of over-cap context is unsafe because it silently deletes whole child tickets and their unmet criteria on epic closes, creating a signed-false-PASS vector
